Wilson MS thesis chapter 2 reports Hesperoyucca whipplei x Tegeticula system and field light towers corresponding to published Wilson et al. 2021, DOI 10.1093/icb/icab010. Treat thesis as source enrichment, not a second independent published experiment.
Original Swiss manipulated community paper models diurnal plant-pollinator visitation, not plant seed/fruit reproductive outcome. Cannot add as reproduction effect even though field manipulated ALAN.

Original 5-lux vs dark x earthworm factorial measures germination of pre-sown seeds, seedling emergence and plant height/biomass. Authors explicitly discuss future/conditional seed production; no flowering fruit or produced seed outcome.
Authors explicitly describe structured literature review, no new assigned ALAN lit-dark fecundity data.
